blocks.text: El inglés académico y formal usa muchos sustantivos donde la lengua hablada usa verbos. El texto queda así más compacto e impersonal.

head: Con verbos (lengua hablada)
Con sustantivos (formal)
rows: Prices rose sharply, so people bought less.
The sharp rise in prices led to a fall in consumption.
We analysed the data and found that ...
Analysis of the data revealed that ...
Because the government decided to raise taxes, ...
Following the government's decision to raise taxes, ...
When the factory closed, many people lost their jobs.
The closure of the factory resulted in widespread job losses.
If we invest more, the economy will grow.
Greater investment will lead to economic growth.

blocks.title: Verbos útiles con las nominalizaciones
blocks.text: lead to, result in, cause, contribute to (causa y efecto), be due to, result from (causa), undergo, carry out, conduct (realizar). The study was conducted in 2020. The decline was due to a lack of funding.

head: Personal
Impersonal
rows: I think that ...
It could be argued that ...
People believe that ...
It is widely believed that ...
We can see that ...
It can be seen that ... / This shows that ...
I will discuss ...
This essay discusses ...
You need to remember that ...
It should be borne in mind that ...

blocks.title: El 'se' impersonal
blocks.text: El se del español (Se puede ver que ..., Se considera que ...) no tiene equivalente directo. Usa la pasiva o construcciones con it: It can be seen that ..., It is considered that ..., As can be seen .... Y no uses you ni we para hablar en general en un texto académico.

blocks.title: Palabras formales (entre paréntesis, la palabra informal)
Ventaja y peligro para el hispanohablante
blocks.text: Las palabras formales inglesas vienen casi siempre del latín y se parecen al español (obtain, demonstrate, require), así que te resultan fáciles. El peligro es el contrario: frases larguísimas llenas de sustantivos, como en el español académico. El buen inglés académico es más directo: nominaliza lo importante y haz frases claras y cortas. Y en textos formales no uses formas cortas (it's, don't) ni signos de exclamación.

rows: The rise of prices caused that people bought less.
The rise in prices caused people to buy less.
a rise in; cause someone to.
It's clear that the data shows this.
It is clear that the data show this.
Formal: sin formas cortas; data suele ir en plural.
advice
You can see that sales went up a lot.
It can be seen that sales increased considerably.
Impersonal y formal.
This research was done by us.
This research was conducted in 2020.
Verbo formal: conduct.
advice
The decrease was because of a lack of money.
The decrease was due to a lack of funding.
Formal: due to, funding.

blocks.text: Completa con la palabra que falta. Las respuestas están en la última página.

items.q: There has been a sharp ______ in unemployment.
items.full: There has been a sharp rise in unemployment.

items.q: The ______ of the factory led to many job losses.
items.full: The closure of the factory led to many job losses.

items.q: It is widely ______ that exercise reduces stress.
items.full: It is widely believed that exercise reduces stress.

items.q: The study was ______ in three countries.
items.full: The study was conducted in three countries.

items.q: The delay was ______ to technical problems.
items.full: The delay was due to technical problems.

items.q: Higher taxes may ______ in lower spending.
items.full: Higher taxes may result in lower spending.

items.q: The results ______ that the method works.
items.full: The results demonstrate that the method works.

items.q: It could be ______ that the policy has failed.
items.full: It could be argued that the policy has failed.
The project will commence in January.

items.q: This job ______ a high level of English.
items.full: This job requires a high level of English.

items.q: Se cree generalmente que fumar es perjudicial.
items.a: It is widely believed that smoking is harmful.

items.q: El cierre de la fábrica provocó desempleo.
items.a: The closure of the factory led to unemployment.

items.q: El retraso se debió a problemas técnicos.
items.a: The delay was due to technical problems.
